wikitext: {{Questbox | name=Thandol Span | start=[[Kixxle]] | end=[[Captain Stoutfist]] | faction=Alliance | id= | level=60 | type= | category=Redridge Mountains | experience = | rewards = | previous = [[Young and Foolish]] | next = [[Are You True to Your Nature?]] }} == Objectives == Bring Vladeus Springriver back to Menethil Harbor and report back to Captain Stoutfist. * Defeat Scarlet Recruits * Bring Vladeus Springriver back to Menethil Harbor * [[Scarlet Recruit's Insignia Ring]] == Description == Yeah bub that's all I know, now I don't say I deserve any kind of compensation for the information but it will highly be appreciated. Fine then, go on and follow the road to that bridge, Thandol Span or whatever, I hope those Scarlets get you for being such a prick! == Progress == The Scarlet Crusade must be put to an end. == Completion == So this is all you could salvage from the idiots that willingly murdered our caravan, eh? I’ll take him to the dungeon, good job. ==Notes== The [[Scarlet Recruit]] ambush at the [[Thandol Span]] is notorious for not triggering properly. In order to properly trigger the ambush, you must delete the [[Scarlet Recruit's Insignia Ring]] that is still in your inventory from {{Alliance}} [60] [[Caravan Meets Caravan]], then abandon the quest and retake it from [[Kixxle]]. Upon approaching the Thandol Span, two [[Scarlet Recruit]]s will appear from the shadows, soon followed by two more, and then finally [[Vladeus Springriver]] will appear.
